transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As we discussed, the middle school is planning to launch the student peer-mediation program for the spring semester. The current draft proposes twelve student mediators, mediation sessions on Mondays and Wednesdays during lunch, one adult supervisor, and referrals for minor and moderate student conflicts. Before I can give final approval for the operating plan, I need to go through the standard student-services approval checklist. So I'd like to ask each of you to report on your assigned checklist item in one uninterrupted round, and I'll record your reports and any required plan changes before making my final decision. Let's start with the peer-mediation advisor -- could you please report on the roster and training status?
